summary: A Yes vote increases the City of Solana Beach's transient occupancy (hotel/lodging) tax paid by visitors by one percent.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports increasing the hotel and lodging tax from 13% to 14%, generating an estimated $250,000 annually for general city purposes.
tax.quote: Currently, the City charges a 13% TOT. If approved, this Measure would increase the TOT rate by 1% for a total of 14% and would generate an estimated $250,000 per year in additional revenue.

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure C, which would raise Solana Beach’s transient occupancy tax from 13% to 14%.
tax.quote: A “yes” vote favors the Measure. A “no” vote opposes the Measure.
